items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Nearly a century ago, restricting diet during early-life periods was suggested to extend lifespan in rats and in
                    <jats:italic>Daphnia</jats:italic>
                    <jats:sup>1,2</jats:sup>
                    . The effect of juvenile diet on adult physiology and lifespan has subsequently been described in other model organisms, including fruit flies
                    <jats:sup>3–5</jats:sup>
                    and mice
                    <jats:sup>6–8</jats:sup>
                    ; however, its mechanism remains poorly understood. Here, using
                    <jats:italic>Drosophila</jats:italic>
                    as a model, we show that restricting protein intake during the larval stage (early-life protein restriction; ePR) promotes adult lifespan by reducing the levels of storage proteins. Using stable-isotope tracing, we show that dietary amino acids obtained in the larval stage are retained into early adulthood, and are incorporated into ribosomal proteins in particular. This is mediated by larval serum protein 2 (Lsp2), a major storage protein, the expression of which is durably downregulated by ePR in the early adult stage. Genetic silencing of
                    <jats:italic>Lsp2</jats:italic>
                    phenocopies ePR, attenuating ribosomal-protein abundance and translational activity in early adulthood, and extending lifespan. Restricting specific amino acids that are especially enriched in these storage proteins, such as phenylalanine and tyrosine, is sufficient to decrease the levels of early-life Lsp2 and promote longevity. These findings identify Lsp2 as a molecular carrier of nutritional history across developmental transitions, linking juvenile nutritional status to adult translational capacity and lifespan. Our study uncovers a previously unrecognized mechanism of nutritional memory that links early-life diet to lifelong organismal health.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《Lsp2将果蝇早期饮食与成体翻译及寿命相关联》：研究以果蝇为模型，结合稳定同位素示踪，发现幼虫期蛋白质限制通过持续下调储存蛋白Lsp2，减少成体早期核糖体蛋白丰度与翻译活性，从而延长寿命，并揭示苯丙氨酸和酪氨酸等特定氨基酸的限制足以产生类似效果，为理解早期营养记忆如何影响终身健康提供了新机制。
items.title: Lsp2 links early-life diet to adult translation and lifespan in Drosophila

items.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Central Australia's ngarrawa, or ‘mound springs’, are unique hydrological systems that serve as some of the only near‐permanent sources of water and continuous sediment deposition in Australia's arid interior. As such, they hold significant potential as palaeo‐climate and ‐environmental archives in a region where many aspects of past climate remain uncertain. To date, few studies have investigated the potential of these sediments, including their stratigraphic integrity or if they can be radiocarbon‐dated. In this study, Itrax X‐ray fluorescence (XRF) scanning was performed on a series of sediment cores taken at Maka (Warburton Springs) to determine sediment integrity at mm scale for sediments that do not clearly show visual structures. Radiocarbon dating was also attempted using different materials, including plant macrofossils, charcoal, one bone remain and an insect carapace. The different materials returned a wide range of potential ages, with the plant macrofossils, which we tentatively consider to be the most robust indicator of sediment age, suggesting that the sediment records extend back to ~700 cal. yr BP at Maka. Highly variable XRF‐inferred elemental profiles indicate that sediments at the ngarrawa are heterogeneous, not heavily mixed, with a trend towards increasingly organic sediments up‐core. The elements Fe, K, Si and Ti are interpreted to reflect different detrital sources throughout the sediments with increasing Fe concentrations, suggesting increased dust mobilisation during recent times. These findings suggest that the XRF data from ngarrawa have potential as palaeoenvironmental archives to support future research into the climate and ecological history of these important desert oases, but still require more robust chronological constraints.</jats:p>

items.title: Ngarrawa (mound spring) sediments as archives of Holocene environmental change in arid central Australia: Insights from Itrax XRF scanning

items.summary: 《从耳石稳定同位素组成重建现代与化石鱼类群落的热生态位与代谢生态位》：该研究利用耳石稳定同位素组成，重建现代和化石鱼类群落的热生态位与代谢生态位，为理解鱼类群落生态特征及其演化提供了新视角，值得古生态学与稳定同位素研究者阅读。
items.title: Reconstructing thermal and metabolic niches in modern and fossil fish communities from otolith stable isotope compositions

items.summary: 《“鬣狗吞食”案例：沙特阿拉伯达丹与塔伊地区古代晚期对条纹鬣狗的屠宰与消费》：该研究通过骨骼证据分析古代晚期两处遗址中条纹鬣狗的屠宰与消费行为，为理解当时人类与鬣狗的互动提供了新视角，适合关注动物考古与古代饮食习俗的读者。
items.title: Cases of “Húainaphagy”: Butchery and consumption of striped hyena during Late Antiquity at Dadan and Thāj (Saudi Arabia)

items.abstract: Ochre has been widely recognised as a material of technological and symbolic significance throughout the Palaeolithic, yet detailed studies of its operational sequence and use in the Aurignacian of northern Central Europe remain rare. This study presents a systematic use-wear and spatial analysis of an Aurignacian ochre assemblage from the open-air site of Friedrichsdorf-Seulberg, Hesse, Germany (38,810–35,150 cal BP). The assemblage comprises 104 ochre pieces exhibiting notable variability in colour, size, hardness, and degrees of anthropogenic modification. Microscopic use-wear analysis, supported by experimental investigation of modern cleaning traces, confidently distinguished signs of ancient abrading, rubbing, and scoring from modern modifications. The results depict a complex chaîne opératoire that entailed powder production and suggest direct application of ochre – principally for hide processing activities such as fleshing, fat removal and tanning. X-ray diffraction analysis revealed the mineral composition and indicated targeted thermal alterations of several of the ochre pieces. Kernel density estimation reveals spatial clustering of modified ochre and lithic artefacts adjacent to the central hearth, highlighting dedicated technological activity zones, while the co-occurrence of ochre and modified faunal remains in eastern refuse areas indicates structured discard practices. Comparative evidence from other Aurignacian sites underscores the interpretive value of integrative, multi-method approaches. Altogether, these results shed new light on ochre’s primary role in hide working at Friedrichsdorf-Seulberg and the complex resource management of Early Upper Palaeolithic groups in northern Central Europe.

items.title: A multi-method approach to the reconstruction of Early Upper Palaeolithic ochre processing: Integrating use-wear, experimental, and spatial data from the Aurignacian site of Friedrichsdorf-Seulberg

items.summary: 《一个物种，多种信号：解读现代与更新世系统中混合觅食跳羚（Antidorcas marsupialis）跨生物群系的牙齿微磨痕质地与中观磨耗》：研究以跳羚为对象，比较不同生物群系下牙齿微磨痕质地与中观磨耗所反映的食性信号，值得阅读以了解同一物种食性信号如何随环境变化。
items.title: One species, many signals: Interpreting dental microwear textures and mesowear in mixed-feeding springbok (Antidorcas marsupialis) across biomes in modern and Pleistocene systems
